# SkyWork Borivali

> SkyWork Borivali is a calm, health-first coworking space on the 15th floor, steps from Borivali railway station in Mumbai, India. Purified air and water, high-speed WiFi with backup connections, air conditioning, and flexible plans from Rs 350. Two identical setups on the same floor with 26 seats in all: 18 dedicated open desks and two 4-seat private cabins.

Key facts:

- Location: 1503, Om Siddhivinayak SRA CHS Ltd, Carter Road No. 1, Near Borivali Railway Station, Behind Kasturba Road Police Station, PBC Building Gate No. 2, Borivali East, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400066
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 9029208698
- Pricing: Virtual Meeting Pass Rs 350 (1-3 hours, additional hour Rs 100) · Full Day Pass Rs 600 · Monthly Rs 6,000
- Policies: strictly vegetarian-only food, no smoking, no alcohol, quiet workspace (virtual meetings at your desk are fine, voice calls in the passage near the lift)
- Amenities: air purifiers, water purifiers, air conditioning, high-speed WiFi with backup connections, ergonomic seating, microwave and electric kettle, 24/7 security cameras, fire extinguisher on site
- Parking: none at the workspace; public parking near Borivali railway station is available
- Reviews: 20 five-star Google reviews from professionals, students, and businesses
